title: Marcel van den Bosch (CFO & CEO · Steward Ownership) puts Incorruptible on his summer list next to Toekomstbedrijven
summary: Van den Bosch is a CFO and CEO working on strategic finance transformation, co-founder of HYMNN, and is exploring steward ownership. He put Incorruptible on his summer reading list next to Toekomstbedrijven by Gijsbert Koren and Nina de Korte, the Dutch text on steward ownership. He frames the book's question as a generational one: whether a company stays true to its purpose as decades pass.
blockquote: After The Lean Startup, Eric Ries turns his attention to mission-led companies — and the forces that can gradually pull them away from their purpose. The big question: how do we build companies that can remain true to their purpose over generations?
blockquote_source: Marcel van den Bosch on LinkedIn
